clearedSpotChecks.check: Shapes that no covered block contains, and whether any line of src/ can produce them.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read every MOD, SMOD, SDIV, SIGNEXTEND, SAR and BYTE site in src/. SMOD and SDIV divide by tickSpacing, which PoolManager.sol:119-120 bounds to 1 through type(int16).max (TickMath.sol:26-28) before a pool exists, and TickBitmap.sol:21, :55 and Pool.sol:576 sign extend it from 3 bytes. SIGNEXTEND indices are the constants 2 and 15, SAR shifts are 8, 128 and 255, and BYTE indices are masked with 0x1f (BitMath.sol:22, :45). The list of MOD divisors leaves out one site: UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp at SqrtPriceMath.sol:208 divides by sqrtPriceAX96. That divisor is guarded nonzero at SqrtPriceMath.sol:197-201 (InvalidPrice), so the conclusion holds. The divisor numerator1 / sqrtPX96 + amount at SqrtPriceMath.sol:52 cannot wrap to zero because numerator1 is below 2^224 and amount comes from an int256 magnitude.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2: whether the counted blocks are the producer blocks.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I queried eth_getBlockByNumber for blocks 52363132, 52418988 and 46002270 on rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, rpc.purroofgroup.com and rpc.hyperlend.finance/archive. On all three endpoints receiptsRoot, gasUsed and the logsBloom prefix are equal (for example 52363132: receiptsRoot 0x0518529b...cebffc26, gasUsed 0x16df7c), and stateRoot is zero on all three. The documentation page states a limit of 100 EVM JSON-RPC requests per minute for rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm. The nanoreth f0cad31 file src/node/consensus/reth_copy.rs checks gas used and then the receipts root and logs bloom, and does not compare state. Storage written without a log is therefore still unverified, as the item says (F-120).

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1 (L-1309): operand shapes that the closed HyperEVM block producer has executed in blocks the public replicas accepted.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The census logic holds within its stated limit. A replica-accepted block shows that the producer's gas used, receipt status and logs match the replica's revm, and reth_copy.rs confirms the replica refuses on those differences. The census therefore shows producer agreement only where a result reaches a log, a branch, gas or status, and only for those operand values at those contracts. It does not exclude a producer path specialised per contract or per pc, which the low-priority lead records, or a wrong word that goes only to storage. I did not rerun the tracer over 52,406 blocks. I checked that the census and header outputs exist in the work directory and that hdr-check.json reports 1001 blocks with 1001 equal. The reach claim for pc 22445/22513 agrees with SwapMath.sol:64-65: the product of |amountRemaining| and MAX_SWAP_FEE - fee goes past 2^256 only for amounts near 2^236 or larger, and an existing pool accepts such an amount because PoolManager.sol:193 rejects only zero.
